title: Habitica Party Check-In Reliability
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:habit party_name=* checkin_done=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(checkin_done="yes",1,0))) as matched by party_name
| eval a_completed_party_check_in_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_completed_party_check_in_pct
description: Measures the percentage of party coordination that end with a completed party check-in by party.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which party are helping or hurting party coordination.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a completed party check-in` on `lifeos:habit` events and summarize the hit rate by `party_name`.
visualization: Table of party with percentage of party coordination ending with a completed party check-in.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a completed party check-in happens for each party so you can see where party coordination go smoothly or get stuck.
